source: refine employer dashboard DS controls and dynamic claims charts

assumptions.text: Used Compass Select for active entity because the user confirmed it is a fixed value choice
Used Compass SidebarTrigger inside an icon-collapsible Sidebar, with a second mobile-only opener in the page header
Used nested Compass Tabs for claim dimension and Count or Amount, plus Compass Alert for the persistent info message
Status uses grouped bars, family member uses stacked bars, and treatments uses lines as the most relevant diagram for each comparison
Dynamic claim values and Entity 2 or Entity 3 options are representative local demo data because no product API was provided
All chart series remain mapped to semantic chart-1 through chart-4 tokens rather than Figma or data-specific colors
CD Balance chart uses Recharts side margins and a fixed axis gutter to prevent edge crowding while Card padding remains system-owned
Claims dimension tabs scroll within their Compass TabsList on narrow screens to avoid page overflow
